canon_law: "Devil" only in our own way/language, never the source game's way. There is NO Jin Kazama in our game at all — the ONLY Jin is the soul JIN (the Blade Soul), pickable as Phantom (Law 2, Jay 2026-11-08 ~00:04). The Devil Jin kit is moveset donor data only, never a character. Names blocked on a Jay-call are PROVISIONAL, never decided here.
